$comment: H12, the facts batch: POST /v1/facts, a factory's fact rows (kind, v, key, payload, seq) from its local facts ledger,
sent by its record's forwarder past its own cursor to Hestia, which keeps every row as truth (hestia 0042,
frontmatter-fact-ledger, crossing agent-slack 0022; review.md 'The recommended shape', R2, R4, R10, R12). The kinds and
their payloads are working-on/expected.json `facts` (Hephaistos's schemas and enums, Q5) and forecast-state.json `fact`;
this file is the wire between the laptop and Hestia, hestia's FSE's. Sample rule and index: contracts/README.md.
How it is used: `rows` is one batch, posted as {"factory": `factory`, "after_seq": `after_seq`, "rows": [<each row>]}
by a key of `factory`, in this order. Every row is answered 200 in `rows` by its seq, with `answer`: `result` stored (new
or changed in the ledger) or unchanged (the ledger holds the same v and payload), and `state` projected (a known kind
and v that keeps its kind's rules: written to the table `projects_to` names), unprojected (an unknown kind or v: kept,
projected once Hestia knows it) or quarantined (a known kind and v that breaks its rules: kept, counted, not projected;
`reason_contains` is a substring of the answer's reason). `response.first` is the answer to the batch, `response.again`
to the same batch sent again, which changes nothing. `must_refuse` is one case per refusal of the whole batch (nothing
stored): `body` is posted as is; `rows` instead is posted as {"factory": `factory`, "after_seq": `after_seq`, "rows":
`rows`}, where the string "rows[0]" stands for rows[0].row; `count` instead is that many copies of rows[0].row with
seq 1..count and key.number suffixed -<n>; `row_bytes` instead is rows[0].row with its payload padded by an unknown
string field `pad` to exactly that many bytes encoded; `body_bytes` is a well-formed batch of exactly that size (pad it
with an unknown top-level string field; the bytes are described, not inlined). `key` is who sends it: `factory` (a key
of `factory`), `another factory`, `no token`, or `token without ingest:write` (an OIDC token of `factory` carrying every
scope but ingest:write). `error_contains` is a substring of the {"error": ...} body.

writers.repo: record (the forwarder, the laptop's facts ledger past its own cursor)

readers.repo: record (Hestia's facts ingest: ledger, facts_history, projections)

settings.max_rows: rows per batch; a sender splits past it
settings.max_row_bytes: one row as JSON, compact (as json.Marshal writes it), kind, v, key, payload and seq together
settings.max_body_bytes: the whole body, fixed in the record (model.MaxBodyBytes), as /v1/ingest and /v1/usage

batch_rules: factory is required and is the key's own factory
after_seq is the sender's cursor: the last seq Hestia answered for this factory, 0 before the first; a whole number, 0 or more
a key outside batch_keys or row_keys, or one that differs from them only by case, refuses the batch
rows may be empty: an empty batch is answered 200 with last_seq after_seq

Hestia does not check after_seq against what it holds for the factory (it keeps no cursor of its own): a resend, or a laptop ledger rebuilt and sent again from 0, is safe, because the ledger is idempotent by (factory, kind, key)
no tombstones: a file removed at the laptop leaves its fact at Hestia as it was last sent (0042 Q8, kept forever); there is no row that deletes a fact

no row's content fails the batch: only the structural cases of must_refuse refuse it whole; a row whose content Hestia cannot project (a rule broken, a number past 2147483647, a U+0000) is quarantined and the rows beside it land (`never_refused` below)
row_rules: kind is a name, ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$; a kind Hestia does not know is kept, not refused
v is a whole number from 1 to 2147483647; a v Hestia does not know for a kind is kept, not refused
key is a non-empty object whose values are non-empty strings or whole numbers: a known kind's key fields less factory, which is the batch's
payload is an object; a field it does not know is kept with it
seq is the sender's change sequence (its own ledger's), a whole number past after_seq and past the row before it in the batch
the ledger holds one row per (factory, kind, key): a row whose v and payload equal the held one's is unchanged (its seq kept, no history); any other replaces it and writes a facts_history row

a later row for the same (factory, kind, key) is the truth: a quarantined row that is sent again keeping the rules is projected, and a projected row replaced by a quarantined one has its projection removed (the projection never holds a version the ledger no longer has; `replaced` below)

a U+0000 anywhere in a row's key or payload (a string or a field name) quarantines the row, whatever its kind, and never refuses the batch: the row is kept with each U+0000 written as the six-character text \u0000 (a key holding one is keyed by that text), and it is never projected, on Rebuild too: a key or payload holding that text is quarantined
the projections are a function of the ledger: rebuilt from it, they are equal

kinds.from: working-on/expected.json facts.kinds (key, less factory) and forecast-state.json fact.key

kind_rules: the key holds exactly the kind's key fields; a key field the payload also holds is equal in both
a key field that is a number (wave, n) is a whole number from 1; a key field that is a time (start, at) is RFC 3339 with an offset
dates (raised, ruled, created, done, date) are YYYY-MM-DD; times (raised_at, ruled_at, launched, merged, start, end, launch, at) are RFC 3339 with an offset
decision.ruled_mode is one of expected.json facts.enums.ruled_mode; decision.forecast is {lo, hi}, whole minutes, 0 <= lo <= hi
card.review_rounds is a whole number from 0
round.cause, finding.kind and amendment.cause are one of expected.json facts.enums.cause
forecast_extension.add_min is a whole number from 1 to 10080 and end is at plus add_min minutes; why is not empty
every whole number of these rules, a key field or a payload field (wave, n, review_rounds, add_min, forecast lo and hi, any other), is at most 2147483647; above it the row is quarantined
a field absent from the payload is absent from the projection (NULL), never guessed

payload.why: usage limit stopped every seat; the review waits on the operator

rows.name: a decision written before 0042: no new field
a known kind at an unknown v
ruled_mode outside the enum
rows.reason_contains: ruled_mode "sometimes" is not present, away or standing rule

rows.name: review_rounds below zero
rows.reason_contains: review_rounds -1 is not a whole number from 0

rows.name: a key field the payload disagrees with
rows.reason_contains: key card "facts-fields" is not the payload's "other-card"

rows.name: a key missing one of its kind's fields
add_min outside 1 to 10080
rows.reason_contains: add_min 0 is not a whole number from 1 to 10080

response.row_note: rows answers every row of the batch, in its order; reason is present only when state is quarantined. The sender moves its cursor to last_seq, the last row's seq (after_seq for an empty batch): every row answered is held, a quarantined one included.

after.note: the same after the first batch and after it is sent again

replaced.$comment: Sent after `rows` (and its resend), each batch in order, by the same key: a projected row replaced by a quarantined one loses its projection, and sent again keeping the rules it is projected again. Each step writes one facts_history row; the ledger keeps one row for the key.

steps.name: the decision 0011 replaced by a version that breaks its rules
steps.reason_contains: ruled_mode "sometimes" is not present, away or standing rule

steps.name: the decision 0011 sent again as rows[0] holds it

never_refused.$comment: Rows whose content Hestia cannot project, each case posted alone by a key of `factory` as {"factory": `factory`, "after_seq": 0, "rows": `rows`} on a ledger that holds none of them: answered 200, every row as `answers` says, in order (`reason_contains` a substring of its reason). `ledger` is what the ledger then holds for each row, key and payload compared by value; `projections` the rows each table then holds. A U+0000 is kept as the text \u0000 and never projected; a number past 2147483647 is quarantined (the review of facts-ingest, F1 and F2; the FSE's ruling).
